test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The children / were warned / to keep away / for the edge of the cliff.

options.text: for the edge of the cliff

solution:
The correct answer is "**for the edge of the cliff**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "*for the edge of the cliff*" is the incorrect segment that contains grammatical error.
 
• The correct sentence would be:
 
 
• ​ The children were warned to keep away of the cliff. ​​​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When a set of words are written down, a ***sentence** *is one that starts with a ***capital letter*** and ends with a ***full stop***, ***question mark***, or ***exclamation mark.***
 
• The majority of sentences have a ***subject*** and a ***verb***.
 
• The biggest independent ***grammatical unit*** is a sentence.
